package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

// GetHybridPlanningSnapshot uses Student's dedicated Planner contour. It never
// combines legacy path/profile/mastery reads into a synthetic observation.
func (client Client) GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string, input domain.HybridSnapshotRequest) (domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot, error) {
	request, err := domain.NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(input)
	if err != nil || !isCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !isCanonicalUUID(pathID) {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.WriteToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/v1/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(pathID) + "/planning-snapshot"
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.WriteToken)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		case http.StatusForbidden, http.StatusUnauthorized:
			return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrForbidden
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
		}
	}
	contentType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || contentType != "application/json" {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, domain.MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	if len(raw) > domain.MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := validateHybridJSONEnvelope(raw); err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := validateHybridJSONShape(raw, reflect.TypeOf(domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}), ""); err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	var snapshot domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&snapshot) != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateHybridPlanningSnapshot(snapshot, studentID, pathID, request); err != nil {
		return domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot{}, err
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

// encoding/json alone accepts duplicate object keys; owner provenance must not
// depend on which decoder happens to win a repeated field.
func validateHybridJSONEnvelope(raw []byte) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var visit func(int) error
	visit = func(depth int) error {
		if depth > 32 {
			return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delimiter, ok := token.(json.Delim)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		switch delimiter {
		case '{':
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for decoder.More() {
				keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				key, ok := keyToken.(string)
				if !ok || key != strings.ToLower(key) || seen[key] {
					return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
				}
				seen[key] = true
				if err = visit(depth + 1); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			close, err := decoder.Token()
			if err != nil || close != json.Delim('}') {
				return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
			}
		case '[':
			for decoder.More() {
				if err := visit(depth + 1); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			close, err := decoder.Token()
			if err != nil || close != json.Delim(']') {
				return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
			}
		default:
			return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := visit(0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := decoder.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

var _ domainservice.HybridStudentSnapshotService = Client{}

// Every nonoptional field must really exist on the owner wire. A missing or
// null zero-valued scalar cannot silently become an apparently valid counter.
func validateHybridJSONShape(raw json.RawMessage, typ reflect.Type, path string) error {
	if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
		switch path {
		case "availability.evidence_quality.value", "availability.stability.value", "availability.runtime_hold.value", "availability.automatic_adaptation.value", "availability.student_pinning.value":
			return nil
		}
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	for typ.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
		typ = typ.Elem()
	}
	if typ.PkgPath() == "time" && typ.Name() == "Time" {
		return nil
	}
	switch typ.Kind() {
	case reflect.Struct:
		var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields) != nil {
			return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		for i := 0; i < typ.NumField(); i++ {
			field := typ.Field(i)
			tag := field.Tag.Get("json")
			parts := strings.Split(tag, ",")
			key := parts[0]
			if key == "-" {
				continue
			}
			if key == "" {
				key = field.Name
			}
			value, ok := fields[key]
			optional := len(parts) > 1 && parts[1] == "omitempty"
			if !ok {
				if optional {
					continue
				}
				return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
			}
			childPath := key
			if path != "" {
				childPath = path + "." + key
			}
			if err := validateHybridJSONShape(value, field.Type, childPath); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case reflect.Slice:
		var values []json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &values) != nil || values == nil {
			return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		for _, value := range values {
			if err := validateHybridJSONShape(value, typ.Elem(), path+"[]"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
